package main

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"studio/internal/bus"
	"studio/internal/bushost"
)

// Compiled against 4fe5a52c without substituting any production source.
func TestGoingBackYesterday(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.Getenv("DINAH_GOING_BACK_ROOT")
	if root == "" {
		t.Fatal("fixture root required")
	}
	previous := configOverride
	oldVersion := appVersion
	t.Cleanup(func() { configOverride = previous; appVersion = oldVersion; closeAppLog() })
	configOverride = filepath.Join(root, "full")
	appVersion = "rollback-old"
	snapshots := map[string]string{}
	for _, name := range []string{"restart-resume.json", "restart-awaiting.json", "webview2/profiles.json", "notifications.json"} {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(configOverride, name))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		snapshots[name] = string(data)
	}
	a := NewApp()
	if a.startupErr != nil {
		t.Fatal(a.startupErr)
	}
	if a.settings.SessionTitles["fixture-chat"] != "Invented chat" {
		t.Fatal("known settings lost")
	}
	t.Log("Yesterday's NewApp starts with current settings and restart/profile files present")
	if _, err := a.Notifications(); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "invalid durable notification") {
		t.Fatalf("expected whole-store incompatibility: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := a.SaveNotification(Notification{ID: "old_new", Kind: "app", Severity: "info", Title: "Invented old-build report"}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("old writer unexpectedly accepted the incompatible store")
	}
	t.Log("Confirmed incompatibility: both reading and adding Notifications fail when new card kinds exist")
	state, err := a.ReadUIState()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if state.Values["dinah-decisions:request%3Afixture"] == nil {
		t.Fatal("new decision draft did not load as opaque UI state")
	}
	state.Values["old-build-check"] = json.RawMessage(`true`)
	if err = a.SaveUIState(state); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s, err := loadSettings()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = saveSettings(s); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(configOverride, "settings.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var raw map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err = json.Unmarshal(data, &raw); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if raw["backgroundChatLimit"] != nil || raw["attentionReadSafe"] != nil {
		t.Fatal("old writer unexpectedly preserves new fields")
	}
	if bushost.BackgroundSlots != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("old fixed background limit %d", bushost.BackgroundSlots)
	}
	t.Log("Confirmed loss on old settings save: background limit and attention migration flag disappear; old limit is three")
	for _, path := range []string{webviewDataPath(), documentWebviewDataPath(), showWebviewDataPath()} {
		if _, err = os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, "invented-marker.txt")); err != nil {
			t.Fatal("adopted old-version profile not reused", err)
		}
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	b, err := bus.OpenAt(filepath.Join(configOverride, "bus.db"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", "file:"+filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(configOverride, "bus.db")))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer db.Close()
	for _, table := range []string{"person_requests", "decision_operations", "decision_previews"} {
		var count int
		if err = db.QueryRow("SELECT count(*) FROM " + table).Scan(&count); err != nil || count != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %d %v", table, count, err)
		}
	}
	var requestID int64
	if err = db.QueryRow("SELECT message_id FROM person_requests").Scan(&requestID); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	message, err := b.Message(ctx, requestID)
	if err != nil || !strings.Contains(message.Text, "Which invented option?") {
		t.Fatalf("request message %+v %v", message, err)
	}
	reply, err := b.Send(ctx, bus.Sender{}, "", "Use the invented second choice.", nil, requestID)
	if err != nil || reply.ReplyTo != requestID {
		t.Fatalf("old reply %+v %v", reply, err)
	}
	if count, err := b.PendingSessionDeliveries(ctx, "fixture-asker"); err != nil || count < 1 {
		t.Fatalf("delivery count %d %v", count, err)
	}
	if err = b.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Log("Yesterday opens the new SQLite schema, reads structured questions as ordinary text and queues a plain reply")
	for name, before := range snapshots {
		data, err = os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(configOverride, name))
		if err != nil || string(data) != before {
			t.Fatalf("%s changed: %v", name, err)
		}
	}
	configOverride = filepath.Join(root, "legacy")
	a = &App{}
	list, err := a.Notifications()
	if err != nil || len(list) != 500 {
		t.Fatalf("legacy notices: %d %v", len(list), err)
	}
	for _, n := range list {
		if n.ID == "mention-1" {
			t.Fatal("old retention unexpectedly kept an eight-day-old mention")
		}
	}
	if _, err = a.SaveNotification(Notification{ID: "ordinary_old", Kind: "app", Severity: "info", Title: "Invented report"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	kept, err := readNotifications()
	if err != nil || len(kept.Items) != 500 {
		t.Fatalf("old pruned rewrite %d %v", len(kept.Items), err)
	}
	t.Log("Old retention hides aged/overflow attention and an ordinary write permanently prunes it")
	configOverride = filepath.Join(root, "restored")
	if err = os.MkdirAll(configOverride, 0o700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"settings.json", "notifications.json"} {
		data, err = os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "full", name+".before-decisions-2026-11-14"))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(configOverride, name), data, 0o600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	restored := NewApp()
	if restored.startupErr != nil {
		t.Fatal(restored.startupErr)
	}
	if restored.settings.Approvals != "ask" || restored.settings.SessionTitles["fixture-chat"] != "Invented chat" {
		t.Fatal("restored settings rejected or changed")
	}
	if list, err := restored.Notifications(); err != nil || len(list) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("restored notifications %v %v", list, err)
	}
	if _, err := restored.SaveNotification(Notification{ID: "restored_new", Kind: "app", Severity: "info", Title: "Invented restored report"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Log("Restoring the two kept copies lets yesterday start, read settings and read/write Notifications")
	configOverride = filepath.Join(root, "different-profile")
	for _, path := range []string{webviewDataPath(), documentWebviewDataPath(), showWebviewDataPath()} {
		if _, err = os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, "invented-marker.txt")); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatalf("old version unexpectedly selected stable profile: %s %v", path, err)
		}
	}
	t.Log("With stable profile-main/documents/show folders, yesterday selects its own version folders and cannot see those markers")
}
